# Templates

Copy a template to start a new document. A placeholder is text between `<` and `>`. Replace each placeholder with your content. The rules do not apply to placeholder text. Each template ends with a rules section. Remove that section in your copy.

## The templates

- [collection-page.md](collection-page.md). The index of a directory.
- [tech-article.md](tech-article.md). A description of one topic.
- [how-to.md](how-to.md). A procedure with steps.
- [api-reference.md](api-reference.md). Reference data in tables.
- [decision-record.md](decision-record.md). A record of one decision.
- [defined-term-set.md](defined-term-set.md). A dictionary part.
